verdict.rationale: A runtime probe found a live llms.txt at phaser.io/llms.txt. It works as a Phaser Examples Index that points agents to a programmatic examples API (GET /api/v1/examples/{id}), so an agent can be pointed at it. However, it covers examples only, not the framework docs: docs.phaser.io/llms.txt and the .md doc variants both return 404, and phaser.io blocks non-browser clients without a browser user agent. The MCP server is a separate capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: llms.txt or markdown versions of the core docs (docs.phaser.io), access for agents without a browser user agent, and independent corroboration of agent use.
